evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting.
evaluations.rationale: Search/discovery is supported by multiple complementary stories (search variants, metadata/tagging, upload) so no single necessary capability is missing for this story.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to search and discover music based on my profile.
evaluations.rationale: This story requires creating and maintaining user profiles (to base searches on) but the backlog contains no stories to create, store or manage user profiles; the complementary 'create/edit profile' capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to search and discover music based on other users similar to myself.
evaluations.rationale: Requires collection and management of user profiles and similarity computation based on stored profiles; there is no story for creating or maintaining user profiles or recording user preferences, so the required complementary capability is absent.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to search and discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity.
evaluations.rationale: The backlog contains multiple similarity/search stories and metadata/tagging that support content-similarity based discovery; no necessary complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to search and discover music by exploiting enriched metadata and image tags, so that I find related artists, new genre, or other relevant listening path.
evaluations.rationale: Enriched metadata/tagging and search stories are present; the story does not require an absent complementary capability in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps.
evaluations.rationale: Upload and tagging is explicitly present; related processing/search stories reference tags, so required complementary capabilities for processing are included.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to view thumbnail sequences of video segments.
evaluations.rationale: Thumbnail/segment viewing can be supported by uploaded tags and existing search/info stories; no absent complementary capability is evident in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to get info about similar video items and segments.
evaluations.rationale: Multiple content-similarity and metadata stories support providing info about similar items; no required complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to get info about perceptually similar video items and segments.
evaluations.rationale: Perceptual similarity is supported by other similarity/search stories; no essential complementary capability is absent from the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to receive content recommendations from similar profiles.
evaluations.rationale: This demands collecting and maintaining user profiles and preferences (and infrastructure to compute similarity/recommendations). The backlog has no story to create or manage user profiles or to collect user preference data, so the complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to receive content recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area.
evaluations.rationale: There are news/video annotation and metadata stories that support news-based recommendations; while ingestion detail is not explicit, complementary admin stories reference news segments, so no clear missing capability.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them.
evaluations.rationale: Identification and enrichment stories exist for multiple entity types; while an external knowledge base is implied, no necessary complementary backlog story is strictly required within this set.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to identify products in videos, and receive related information about them.
evaluations.rationale: Similar to other identification stories; the backlog contains related recognition/enrichment items and no explicit complementary capability is obviously missing from the set.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them.
evaluations.rationale: Logo/brand identification is covered by identification stories; no absent complementary capability in backlog is required to implement this feature.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them.
evaluations.rationale: Brand identification aligns with other recognition/enrichment items in backlog; complementary capabilities appear present at a high level.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image.
evaluations.rationale: There are image tagging, similarity and search stories that provide the necessary complementary functionality for image-to-video recommendation.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to walk around, access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area, monuments or any other relevant point of interest.
evaluations.rationale: Geospatial discovery is supported by metadata/tagging stories; no required complementary story (e.g., geotagging) is clearly missing because enriched metadata stories cover that area.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to search content items using automatic speech recognition.
evaluations.rationale: ASR-based search is a specific search modality and the backlog contains general search and processing stories; no missing complementary capability is evident.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to see, validate and edit segmentation of videos.
evaluations.rationale: Segment viewing and admin editing can be supported by uploaded tags and other processing stories; while automated segmentation generation is not explicit, the backlog contains related processing tasks that make this feasible, so no clear mandatory complementary story is missing.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment.
evaluations.rationale: News/video annotation and topic extraction are present as admin tasks; complementary segmentation/annotation functionality is implied elsewhere in backlog, so no explicit missing capability is evident.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects.
evaluations.rationale: Filtering and ranking based on A/V quality is self-contained and does not require a missing complementary capability in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to get a quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload.
evaluations.rationale: This detection/assessment task is an isolated capability and the backlog provides admin processing stories; no complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to prefilter nudity content.
evaluations.rationale: Prefiltering/moderation stories are present; related ingestion and admin workflows exist (e.g., other prefilter stories), so no missing complementary capability is evident.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information.
evaluations.rationale: Prefilter via search over low-level info is supported by search/tagging stories in the backlog; required complements exist.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement.
evaluations.rationale: Automatic validation of ingested content is a specific processing capability; upload/ingestion stories exist, so no missing complementary capability is evident.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to prefilter the content using search on high­level asset information such as metadata and tags either recognized by the system of provided by the user.
evaluations.rationale: High-level metadata/tag-based prefiltering is consistent with other metadata/tagging and search stories; complements are present.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk.
evaluations.rationale: This requires citizen annotations and Talk comments, but the backlog contains no stories enabling volunteers to annotate/classify subjects or post comments (no volunteer-facing annotation or Talk functionality), so the complementary capability to collect those inputs is missing.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject, based on annotations and information from Talk comments.
evaluations.rationale: Relies on volunteer annotations and Talk comments, but the backlog lacks stories enabling volunteers to create those annotations/comments; the complementary volunteer-contribution capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to identify volunteer types.
evaluations.rationale: Identifying volunteer types requires collecting volunteer behavior/data; the backlog has no stories for volunteer actions or capturing volunteer data (no volunteer-facing classification/interaction stories), so required complementary capabilities are absent.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low­level image features.
evaluations.rationale: Automated preclassification is self-contained; no additional complementary story is required to implement this capability.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to automatically detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals in them.
evaluations.rationale: Automated detection can be implemented with available processing stories; no missing complementary capability in backlog is evident.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic image series detection for the case of timestamping malfunction in Snapshot Serengeti images.
evaluations.rationale: A specific automated processing task; the backlog includes related detection/processing stories so no necessary complement is missing.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti.
evaluations.rationale: Automated preclassification is supported by domain-specific processing stories; no missing complementary capability is evident.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti.
evaluations.rationale: Similar domain-specific automated processing; backlog supports implementation without missing complementary stories.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti.
evaluations.rationale: Domain-specific automated detection is self-contained; no complementary capability is missing from the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal.
evaluations.rationale: The backlog includes this specific segmentation capability; it does not depend on absent complementary stories to be implemented.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to automatically detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton in them.
evaluations.rationale: Automated detection capability is present as a domain-specific task; no missing complementary capability in backlog.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic detection of plankton size or orientation in Plankton Portal images.
evaluations.rationale: Domain-specific automated processing is included; no absent complementary capability is evident.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic preclassification of plankton species in Plankton Portal images.
evaluations.rationale: Automated preclassification is self-contained and supported by other processing stories; no missing complement.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration in Worm Watch Lab.
evaluations.rationale: Specific automated processing story; no additional complementary story in backlog is required to implement it.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to automatically detect the time in a Worm Watch Lab video where the worm lays an egg.
evaluations.rationale: This detection task is self-contained and the backlog supports such domain-specific processing; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads etc in the satellite images.
evaluations.rationale: Automated detection of features in satellite imagery is covered by the backlog's processing stories; no absent complementary capability is evident.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience.
evaluations.rationale: Assessing volunteer experience requires that volunteers' classifications and experience are recorded; the backlog contains no stories enabling volunteers to perform classifications or for storing volunteer contribution histories, so the complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to perform prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors.
evaluations.rationale: Automated prefiltering is a self-contained processing capability and does not depend on absent complementary features.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to detect moving and transient objects in the images.
evaluations.rationale: Automated detection is supported by backlog processing items; no necessary complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files.
evaluations.rationale: Audio denoising is a processing capability present in backlog; no missing complement to implement it.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to group whale calls that are similar.
evaluations.rationale: Clustering/grouping audio is supported by other audio processing stories; no absent complementary capability is evident.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file.
evaluations.rationale: Specific detection/counting capability; backlog contains audio analysis stories so required complements exist.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know when I should interrupt a volunteer.
evaluations.rationale: Determining interruptions presupposes a mechanism to observe/track volunteer activity and to interrupt them; the backlog contains no volunteer-facing stories (no volunteer actions, no UI for volunteers), so the complementary capability to detect and interact with volunteers is missing.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video.
evaluations.rationale: This presumes mechanisms to interrupt volunteers and deliver content; backlog lacks volunteer interaction and interruption mechanism stories, so a necessary complementary capability is absent.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know when I should educate a volunteer.
evaluations.rationale: Requires capturing volunteer behavior and an education/intervention delivery mechanism; backlog does not include volunteer-facing classification/tracking or intervention delivery stories, so complementary capabilities are missing.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video.
evaluations.rationale: As above, this needs volunteer tracking and an intervention delivery system; those volunteer-facing capabilities are not present in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin,I want to know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer.
evaluations.rationale: Selecting education requires data about volunteer performance and interactions; the backlog lacks stories for volunteers to perform tasks or for storing their performance, so necessary complementary capabilities are missing.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject.
evaluations.rationale: This requires a Talk/comment system and volunteer commenting capability; the backlog contains no stories enabling volunteers to post comments or a Talk feature, so the complementary capability is absent.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject.
evaluations.rationale: Requires volunteer comments and subject comment streams to exist so Zoonibot can act; the backlog lacks volunteer comment/Talk stories, so the complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know when Zoonibot should give an explanation.
evaluations.rationale: This depends on volunteer interactions and a commenting/explanation delivery mechanism; absent volunteer-facing comment/interaction stories make the complementary capability missing.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer.
evaluations.rationale: Requires Talk/comment infrastructure and volunteer interaction traces to inform Zoonibot; backlog has no volunteer comment/tracking stories, so the complementary capability is absent.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to group subjects by similarity.
evaluations.rationale: Grouping by similarity is supported by other similarity and clustering stories; no additional complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences.
evaluations.rationale: Requires storage of volunteers' past activity/experience and volunteer-facing activity capture; the backlog contains no stories enabling volunteer activity capture or histories, so necessary complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them.
evaluations.rationale: Article summarization is a self-contained admin feature; while ingestion is implied, there are related admin/content processing stories so no mandatory complementary capability is clearly absent.
